title: Triage a dependency scan by deployment context
method: Synthetic classification of forty findings after reviewing the built artifact and application paths. Reachability is evidence-dependent. Categories do not replace severity, exploitability, compensating controls or a documented release decision.
alt: Triage a dependency scan by deployment context: Deployed and reachable 8 findings, Deployed uncertain reach 12 findings, Development-only scope 20 findings. Illustrative inputs.
